_note: Labels written by Claude for testing the evidence checker. Not user research.
_expect: trap: what makes the case hard (null = a plain pass). verdict: checked only when the listing text states the requirement (quote is an exact, whole-word substring of title + description + key_features + attribute values + sizes + condition); didnt_match when the listing contradicts it; couldnt_check when it is silent or only loosely related. For kind quantity, the checker judges whether one unit of the listing is the unit the shopper counted. critical_if_wrong: a wrong 'checked' on this case breaks the shopper's trust. final_sale: the listing says it can't be returned. Quotes shorter than 6 characters must be a whole field (a size, the condition). One listing can carry several requirements; each is its own case. Channel3 listings (source channel3) are trimmed excerpts of the Nov 5 snapshot: only attributes the case needs are kept.

listing.title: Fast-trac Nitro Gore-tex Men's Waterproof Trail Running Shoes
listing.description: These men's waterproof trail running shoes from PUMA are designed for speed and control on challenging terrain. They feature NITROFOAM™ cushioning for responsive energy return and PUMAGRIP ATR rubber for superior traction on varied surfaces. The GORE-TEX® membrane ensures waterproof protection, while the upper is constructed with at least 20% recycled materials for sustainability.
key_features: PUMAGRIP ATR for grip on varying terrains
Made with at least 20% recycled materials

expect.why: "Energy return" describes the foam, and the listing says nothing about the store's return policy.

listing.title: Men's Cloudvista 2 Waterproof Trail Running Shoes
listing.description: The On Men's Cloudvista 2 Waterproof Trail Running Shoes are designed for trail running across mixed terrain and short to medium distances. They feature a waterproof membrane made with 20% recycled materials and a protective ripstop vamp mesh upper. The shoe is engineered for performance with a springy, two-pronged Speedboard® for rebound and a Helion™ superfoam midsole for energy return. Traction is provided by an ultra-sticky Missiongrip™ rubber outsole with an aggressive lug profile.
key_features: Two-pronged Speedboard® for rebound and responsiveness
Helion™ superfoam midsole for energy return
Ultra-sticky Missiongrip™ rubber outsole with aggressive lug profile

expect.why: "Energy return" and "rebound" are about the midsole, not about sending the shoes back.

listing.title: Mach 6 Road Running Shoes
listing.description: These Hoka Mach 6 Road Running Shoes for men are designed for speed and responsiveness, making them ideal for everyday runs and races. They feature a lightweight, breathable creel jacquard upper with zonal breathability and a midfoot lock-down for a secure fit. The midsole is made of super critical EVA foam for enhanced energy return, and the durabrasion rubber outsole provides strategic coverage for durability and traction. With a neutral stability and moderate cushioning, these shoes offer a responsive feel and a streamlined design for optimal performance. They also incorporate sustainable components in their construction.
key_features: Lightest, most responsive Mach to date
Super critical foam midsole for extra energy return
Strategic rubber coverage in outsole for enhanced durability
Creel jacquard upper with zonal breathability
Best for: Road running, Everyday Run, Race

expect.why: "Extra energy return" is a cushioning claim, and no return terms appear anywhere in the listing.

listing.title: Nike Pegasus 42
listing.description: Experience an energized ride with the Nike Pegasus 42 Men's Road Running Shoes. These shoes feature responsive, full-length cushioning with a full-length Air Zoom unit and ReactX foam midsole for a propulsive feel and excellent energy return. The breathable mesh upper is softer and more comfortable than previous iterations, while an updated fit provides more space in the forefoot and toe box. The high-abrasion rubber outsole with flex grooves offers reliable traction and flexibility. The design is elevated with a unique abstract graphic print inspired by mental strength, making them perfect for everyday road runs.

expect.why: "Regular" and "Wide" are widths, so the listing doesn't say whether size 8 exists.

listing.title: Men's Nova 4 Waterproof Trail Running Shoes
listing.description: These Merrell Nova 4 Waterproof trail running shoes are designed for both performance on the trail and everyday wear. They feature a waterproof membrane to keep feet dry while allowing moisture to escape, and a breathable engineered mesh and TPU upper. The shoes are constructed with recycled materials, including laces, webbing, and part of the footbed and lining. Comfort is provided by a FLEXconnect® midsole with dual-directional flex-grooves and a FloatPro™ Foam midsole for lightweight cushioning. The Merrell Quantum Grip™ rubber outsole ensures durable traction on various terrains. Key features include a bellows tongue to keep out debris, a padded collar, and Cleansport NXT™ treatment for odor control. These are vegan-friendly shoes.
key_features: Waterproof membrane seals out water and lets moisture escape
Breathable engineered mesh and TPU upper
Cleansport NXT™ treated for natural odor control

expect.why: "M" and "W" are width codes, not shoe sizes, so size 8 can't be confirmed.
